newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - NATWEST KEEPS NESTE HOLD.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NATWEST KEEPS NESTE HOLD.

text.p: NatWest Securities said in a research note on Monday it reaffirmed its hold recommendation on Finnish oil, chemicals and energy group Neste Oy .

"Neste is emerging from its expansionary and recession-hit past, its core businesses, refining and gas, achieve above-average returns, and the development of the Asgard field and the sale of its Borealis stake should improve returns in the upstream and chemicals, where Neste has historically underperformed," NatWest said.
On the downside, it said Neste lacked the upstream exposure and international diversification of the European majors, and that it had "the highest level of state ownership (83.6 percent)."
"Neste's business mix and its narrow geographic focus means that it is likely to continue to trade at discount to the European major oil companies," NatWest added.
It forecast Neste's first-tertial profit, due for release on Wednesday, at 506 million markka -- above the median of 12 other forecasts in a Reuters poll.
